cohort: The study included 430 postpartum women, aged 18 years or older, who were admitted to two study hospitals in Indonesia.
finding: The study successfully developed predictive models for postpartum SUI among women in Indonesia, which included pre-pregnancy BMI, Kegel exercises, constipation, fetal weight, SUI during pregnancy, and mode of delivery, demonstrating satisfactory calibration and discrimination.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as one of the significant variables included in the predictive model for postpartum SUI.
